name: WhatsApp
title: whatsapp.com
shortDescription: WhatsApp provides secure and reliable messaging and calling services globally. It allows users to communicate privately with end-to-end encryption, ensuring that only the communicating users can access the messages. Ideal for personal use and business communications, WhatsApp facilitates group chats, voice, and video calls. An example use case includes coordinating events or daily communications among friends, family, or teams.
